lane: MDPS-88 matched-domain physics surface with distance-regime emission (single method)

data.restore: scripts/restore_inputs.py (all SHA-256 pins must pass; abort on mismatch)
data.provenance_flag: owner-mirrored inputs; independent organizer authentication unavailable; competition rasters stay gitignored in data/

features: src/gems88/physics.py ALL_PHYS_FEATURES (44 label-blind columns: 26 from the 19-band stack + 18 official-source externals). No catalogue-distance or trace-geometry column enters the classifier.

holdout.evaluator: vendor/gems57/evaluate_holdout.py gems57-pooled-hide-v2 (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel)
holdout.primary_endpoint: far subset: withheld positives >10 px from every visible catalogue pixel, pooled HOLDOUT-DTI
holdout.bootstrap: paired 20 km physical-block percentile, 1000 draws, seed 520810 (vendor pooled_summary)
holdout.leakage_canary: each of the 44 features alone: symmetric ROC AUC (withheld positives vs 8x off-catalogue negatives, d_cat>3) must be <= 0.90 or STOP

arms_same_folds.base283: control: all-visible-positive HGB (halo.fit_fold_models mode=base), allowed d_vis>2, Dinkelbach allocator min_spacing 2.83 px
arms_same_folds.mdps_far: isolated-positive far-background HGB (mode=fbmt), allowed d_vis>8 only (matched allocation), same allocator/spacing
arms_same_folds.mdps_mix: candidate: regime-stratified allocation merged into one raster: far head allocated at d_vis>8 with k_far = k_est x (training-quadrant withheld-truth share at d_vis>8); near head (base model) allocated separately at 2<d_vis<=8 restricted to >=99th percentile of near-regime p, budget capped at floor(0.25*n_far) (<=20% of total), k_near analogously share-scaled; near dots within 2.83 px of a far dot dropped; same allocator/spacing in both regimes
arms_same_folds.r0_fixed: fixed shipped H33 raster scored per fold (fold-UNFAIR reference; USER-REPORTED live 0.2778)
arms_same_folds.prov_fixed: fixed shipped PROVCREST raster scored per fold (fold-UNFAIR reference)

experiment_budget.E1: canary + fold loop for base283/mdps_far/mdps_mix + fixed controls
experiment_budget.E2: only if E1 candidate fails paired far test by a near miss: ONE pre-declared variation (near-cap 0% i.e. mdps_far becomes candidate) using E1 checkpoints, no new features
experiment_budget.E3: final full-catalogue fit of the winning config + uniqueness lane-cap (vendor halo_constraints, cap 66% per sparse registry prior) + format validation; holdout cost of the cap reported if applied

promotion_gates_all_required: candidate far HOLDOUT-DTI > base283 far with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0
candidate far point estimate > 0.11478 (stored ADHR far on identical folds; UNPAIRED reference, labelled as such)
candidate overall HOLDOUT-DTI >= base283 overall point estimate

uniqueness vs every restored registry raster + tracked docs/downloads candidates: vendor binding_duplicate_decision_v3 duplicate=false (surface |Spearman| <=0.90; excess 3px overlap <=0.70); literal overlaps also reported

format: vendor validate all_checks_passed on on-disk bytes (single band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, pinned transform, no NaN/inf anywhere, values in [0,1], 0 outside footprint, 0 on catalogue) + one-member ZIP roundtrip byte-identical
on_any_gate_failure: verdict negative; file name carries DO-NOT-SUBMIT; site badge = OK TO DOWNLOAD (research) / NOT OK TO SUBMIT; no weekly slot recommended
score_labelling: every number labelled HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator, withheld n, 95% CI) / ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED (none) / USER-REPORTED CLAIM / MODEL-PROJECTION; a projection is never written as a score
slots: this session spends 0 DrivenData slots; final submit click is a human selector decision
